item.wandscape.advanced_magic_compass.de.zh_cn: 指针始终指着本镇的市政厅，并且在物品提示里显示市政厅的坐标。
item.wandscape.advanced_magic_compass.de.en_us: Its needle always points at your town hall, and its tooltip also shows the town hall's coordinates.

item.wandscape.compass.tooltip.points_to.zh_cn: 始终指向城镇市政厅的位置
item.wandscape.compass.tooltip.points_to.en_us: Always points toward your town hall

item.wandscape.compass.tooltip.right_cli.zh_cn: 右键传送到市政厅位置
item.wandscape.compass.tooltip.right_cli.en_us: Right-click to teleport to the town hall

item.wandscape.element.tooltip.zh_cn: 获得后自动存入所在小镇的仓库元素栏
item.wandscape.element.tooltip.en_us: Auto-deposits into the nearest town's warehouse when obtained

item.wandscape.follow_wand.desc.zh_cn: 对着你自己的法师右键，就能切换他的跟随状态。开启后他会跟着你走，不再接取城镇任务。
item.wandscape.follow_wand.desc.en_us: Right-click one of your own mages to toggle follow mode; while it is on they tag along with you instead of taking town tasks.

item.wandscape.follow_wand.tooltip.zh_cn: 右键你的法师：切换跟随/非跟随
item.wandscape.follow_wand.tooltip.en_us: Right-click a mage: toggle follow / no-follow

item.wandscape.guide_book.tooltip.en_us: Right-click to open the mod guidebook

item.wandscape.hostile_wand.desc.zh_cn: 对着生物右键，你小镇的法师就会集中火力打它。再右键一次或者目标死亡就会解除，右键另一个生物则把目标转移过去。
item.wandscape.hostile_wand.desc.en_us: Right-click a creature and your town's mages will focus their fire on it. Right-click it again, or let it die, to clear the order; right-clicking another creature moves the focus there.

item.wandscape.hostile_wand.tooltip.zh_cn: 右键生物：本镇法师集火它（再次右键/目标死亡解除，右键另一生物转移）
item.wandscape.hostile_wand.tooltip.en_us: Right-click a creature: town mages focus it (right-click again / target death clears; right-click another transfers)

item.wandscape.magic_compass.desc.zh_cn: 指针始终指着本镇的市政厅。
item.wandscape.magic_compass.desc.en_us: Its needle always points at your town hall.

item.wandscape.oath_ring.desc.zh_cn: 可以把本镇的一名法师收进戒指里随身带着走。按住 shift 右键法师把他存进去，之后右键方块或者空气把他放出来。这一档能存取 1 名法师。
item.wandscape.oath_ring.desc.en_us: Stores a mage of your own town inside the ring so you can carry them around. Shift+right-click a mage to store them, then right-click a block or the air to release them. This tier holds 1 mage.

item.wandscape.oath_ring_high.desc.zh_cn: 可以把本镇的一名法师收进戒指里随身带着走。按住 shift 右键法师把他存进去，之后右键方块或者空气把他放出来。这一档能存取 4 名法师。
item.wandscape.oath_ring_high.desc.en_us: Stores a mage of your own town inside the ring so you can carry them around. Shift+right-click a mage to store them, then right-click a block or the air to release them. This tier holds 4 mages.

item.wandscape.oath_ring_mid.desc.zh_cn: 可以把本镇的一名法师收进戒指里随身带着走。按住 shift 右键法师把他存进去，之后右键方块或者空气把他放出来。这一档能存取 2 名法师。
item.wandscape.oath_ring_mid.desc.en_us: Stores a mage of your own town inside the ring so you can carry them around. Shift+right-click a mage to store them, then right-click a block or the air to release them. This tier holds 2 mages.

item.wandscape.omni_scepter.desc.zh_cn: 万能权杖把和平、跟随、庇护、敌对四种权杖的功能合在了一起。按住 shift 右键切换模式，右键使用当前模式。
item.wandscape.omni_scepter.desc.en_us: The omni scepter folds peace, follow, shelter and hostile into a single item. Shift+right-click to switch modes, and right-click to use the current one.

item.wandscape.omni_scepter.tooltip.zh_cn: shift+右键切换模式；右键使用当前模式
item.wandscape.omni_scepter.tooltip.en_us: Shift+Right-Click to switch mode; Right-Click to use the current mode

item.wandscape.peace_wand.desc.zh_cn: 对着你自己的法师右键，就能切换他的和平状态，让他不再攻击任何生物。
item.wandscape.peace_wand.desc.en_us: Right-click one of your own mages to toggle peace mode, so they stop attacking anything.

item.wandscape.peace_wand.tooltip.zh_cn: 右键你的法师：切换和平/取消和平
item.wandscape.peace_wand.tooltip.en_us: Right-click a mage: toggle peace / no-peace

item.wandscape.shelter_wand.desc.zh_cn: 对着生物右键，就能把它标记为盟友，你的法师既不会攻击它也不会误伤它。再右键一次即可解除。
item.wandscape.shelter_wand.desc.en_us: Right-click a creature to mark it as an ally, so your mages will neither attack it nor hit it by accident. Right-click it again to release.

item.wandscape.shelter_wand.tooltip.zh_cn: 右键生物：标记为盟友（法师不攻击/不误伤），再次右键解除
item.wandscape.shelter_wand.tooltip.en_us: Right-click a creature: mark as ally (mages won't attack/hurt it); right-click again to release

item.wandscape.spell.creative_hint.zh_cn: 创造模式：右键在当前位置施放
item.wandscape.spell.creative_hint.en_us: Creative: right-click to cast in place

item.wandscape.spell.creative_only.zh_cn: 仅创造模式可右键施放（测试用）
item.wandscape.spell.creative_only.en_us: Creative mode only for right-click casting (test)

item.wandscape.spell.invalid.zh_cn: 绑定的魔法无效或不可直接施放
item.wandscape.spell.invalid.en_us: Bound spell is invalid or not direct-castable

item.wandscape.spell.not_bound.zh_cn: 此魔法卷轴未绑定任何魔法
item.wandscape.spell.not_bound.en_us: This spell scroll has no spell bound

item.wandscape.ultimate_magic_compass.de.zh_cn: 指针始终指着本镇的市政厅，右键还能直接传送到那里。
item.wandscape.ultimate_magic_compass.de.en_us: Its needle always points at your town hall, and right-clicking teleports you straight there.

item.wandscape.wand.desc.zh_cn: 法杖是法师的主手装备，装到法师手上之后，它带的属性加成才会生效，比如提升法术强度、建造速度或者最大法力。玩家自己拿在手里是没有任何加成的。
item.wandscape.wand.desc.en_us: A wand is a mage's main-hand item, and the attribute bonus it carries only takes effect once it is equipped on a mage. A player holding one gains nothing from it.

item.wandscape.warehouse_terminal.desc.zh_cn: 右键就能打开本镇的仓库面板。放进 Curios 的手饰槽后，还可以用快捷键打开。
item.wandscape.warehouse_terminal.desc.en_us: Right-click to open your town's warehouse panel. Put it in a Curios hands slot and you can also open it with a hotkey.

item.wandscape.warehouse_terminal.toolti.zh_cn: 右键打开本镇的仓库面板
item.wandscape.warehouse_terminal.toolti.en_us: Right-click to open your town's warehouse panel

item.wandscape.warehouse_terminal.toolti.zh_cn: 可放入 Curios 手饰槽；穿戴后可使用快捷键打开
item.wandscape.warehouse_terminal.toolti.en_us: Can be placed in Curios hands slot; press key to open while equipped

item.wandscape.item_blueprint.desc.zh_cn: 记录着失落炼金图式的羊皮图纸。可在仓库的配方图鉴中自选解锁任意一个工作站合成配方。
item.wandscape.item_blueprint.desc.en_us: A parchment diagram recording lost alchemical blueprints. Can be consumed in the warehouse recipe book to unlock any workstation synthesize recipe.

item.wandscape.item_blueprint.tooltip.zh_cn: 在仓库配方图鉴中消耗 1 张自选解锁任意合成配方
item.wandscape.item_blueprint.tooltip.en_us: Consume 1 in warehouse recipe book to unlock any synthesize recipe
